title: Cash Drag Alert in Investment Accounts
app: Monarch Money, Copilot Money, Plaid-connected accounts, Plaid investments, and brokerage CSV exports ingested into Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=plaid:investment
| stats latest(cash_pct) as cash_pct by account
| where cash_pct>15
| sort - cash_pct
description: Uses Plaid investment account exports telemetry to monitor how much of each investment account is sitting in cash in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for cash drag that may be larger than intended, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Plaid investment account exports data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It gathers how much of each investment account is sitting in cash so you can spot cash drag that may be larger than intended before it becomes annoying.
